col0: The SME sector is often hailed as an important engine of economic growth. But recent research suggests that young rather than small firms are the main contributors to employment growth. This paper shows that young firms are also key contributors to profit growth across advanced economies. It them examines the impact of financial constraints on profitability across the age distribution of SMEs. We find that start-ups which report finance as their greatest constraint receive smaller new loans and evidence that financing constraints reduce start-up profitability. We do not find a similar relationship for older SMEs in pre-crisis data. Therefore, policy initiatives which ease financing constraints for start-ups could play an important role in boosting economic growth. The SME sector is frequently praised as a vital engine for economic expansion. Yet recent studies indicate that young, rather than small, firms are the primary drivers of job creation. This paper demonstrates that young firms also play a central role in profit growth in advanced economies. It then explores how financial constraints affect profitability across the age spectrum of SMEs. We observe that start-ups citing finance as their main constraint obtain smaller new loans, and evidence suggests these constraints lower start-up profitability. Pre-crisis data does not reveal a comparable link for older SMEs. Thus, policies that alleviate financing barriers for start-ups could significantly enhance economic growth. However, after Europe’s prolonged financial crisis, we also find that financial constraints diminished profitability among more mature firms that were start-ups just before the crisis.

The network will use the same service it used in 2013 called Vidpresso, but instead of showing just Instagram pics, it'll also air tweets and Facebook status updates. Anchors or the people behind the camera merely have to choose the posts they want to broadcast, and they'll show up instantly as tickers or graphics, without the need for further editing. Vidpresso, which was founded by former Engadget editor Randall Bennett, provides broadcasters an affordable way to get viewers involved in discussions on air. It needs only some pieces of hardware (a Blackmagic Ultrastudio 4K and a scan converter, among a handful of others) and a subscription to the service. The system needs to know that you want your posts shown on TV, though. So, you'll have to take a break from prepping that turkey, make those profiles public and tag every post you don't mind showing the whole country with #tdaycbs.

Oregon Governor Kate Brown issued a state of emergency declaration for 13 counties on Thursday evening. This action comes after several days of intense rainfall and strong winds, which have resulted in two fatalities. The severe weather has caused widespread flooding and numerous landslides. The counties under the emergency declaration include Benton, Clackamas, Clatsop, Columbia, Lane, Lincoln, Linn, Marion, Multnomah, Polk, Tillamook, Washington, and Yamhill.

In a statement released Thursday, Brown noted, "Heavy precipitation and high winds have forced evacuations, while mudslides and floodwaters have significantly damaged or closed major highways in these regions. This declaration enables the mobilization of state resources, emergency personnel, and equipment to support communities once local capacities are overwhelmed."

The declaration empowers the Office of Emergency Management to implement the state's emergency operations plan and aid the impacted counties in their recovery. The governor's office stated that the state of emergency will continue indefinitely until further notice.

Additionally, it authorizes state transportation officials to pursue federal aid for roadway repairs. Earlier, on Wednesday, Washington Governor Jay Inslee declared a state of emergency for his entire state.

col0: Attention networks have proven to be an effective approach for embedding categorical inference within a deep neural network. However, for many tasks we may want to model richer structural dependencies without abandoning end-to-end training. In this work, we experiment with incorporating richer structural distributions, encoded using graphical models, within deep networks. We show that these structured attention networks are simple extensions of the basic attention procedure, and that they allow for extending attention beyond the standard soft-selection approach, such as attending to partial segmentations or to subtrees. We experiment with two different classes of structured attention networks: a linear-chain conditional random field and a graph-based parsing model, and describe how these models can be practically implemented as neural network layers. Experiments show that this approach is effective for incorporating structural biases, and structured attention networks outperform baseline attention models on a variety of synthetic and real tasks: tree transduction, neural machine translation, question answering, and natural language inference. We further find that models trained in this way learn interesting unsupervised hidden representations that generalize simple attention.

We demonstrate that these structured attention networks are straightforward extensions of the basic attention mechanism, enabling attention to go beyond conventional soft-selection methods, such as focusing on partial segmentations or subtrees. Experiments indicate that this method effectively incorporates structural biases, with structured attention networks surpassing baseline attention models across various synthetic and real-world tasks: tree transduction, neural machine translation, question answering, and natural language inference. SysFs Interface:

* /sys/class/misc/touchwake/enabled (rw): 1 = on / 0 = off  
  Enable or disable TouchWake (default is disabled).  
  Note: Pressing the power key to turn off the device will deactivate TouchWake.

* /sys/class/misc/touchwake/delay (rw):  
  Sets the delay in milliseconds for the touchscreen or pen to remain active after the screen turns off.  
  Warning: A value of 0 means "infinite" and will significantly drain the battery.

* /sys/class/misc/touchwake/proximity_threshold (rw):  
  Defines the threshold at which the proximity sensor is considered triggered, disabling TouchWake.  
  This acts as in-call detection to prevent the screen from turning on when the device is held to the ear.

* /sys/class/misc/touchwake/use_wakelock (rw): 1 = on / 0 = off  
  Enable or disable using a wakelock to keep the device awake while TouchWake is active (default is enabled).

* /sys/class/misc/touchwake/version (ro):  
  Shows the current version of TouchWake.

* /sys/class/misc/touchwake/debug (ro):  
  Displays debugging information (only available if debugging was enabled during compilation).

Such institutions frame themselves as conservation champions, yet their practices frequently mirror the very disruptions they claim to mitigate. The brothers’ reunion is not a triumph but a reminder of the artificial constraints imposed on sentient beings for human-defined goals. True conservation should minimize trauma, not manufacture moments of manufactured joy for public consumption. Until then, every viral video of animal “happiness” in captivity carries the silent weight of compromise—and control.

Airlines are exploring innovative methods to enhance passenger journeys. This includes upgraded seating and expanded entertainment choices. Looking ahead, they may also offer highly customized services for each traveler.

In his will of 1832, Jeremy Bentham directed his friend Dr. Southwood Smith to take charge of his remains after death—and what a request it was! Bentham wanted his body preserved and displayed as an “Auto-Icon,” a sort of philosophical monument to reason and utility. Today, you can still visit this unusual figure at University College London—where he sits, watching over meetings and even listed as “present but not voting” in official records. It’s equal parts eerie and endearing, a testament to Bentham’s quirky commitment to transparency and legacy. Whether you find him inspiring or just plain odd, there’s no denying: Jeremy Bentham knew how to make an exit—and stick around for the aftermath.

col0: The following steps allowed me to get the Windows 8 Mail app to talk to an Exchange server which uses a self-signed certificate: Open up Internet Explorer and navigate to your Exchange server’s Outlook Web App (OWA) address—typically something like https://mail.yourdomain.com/owa. You’ll likely see a certificate warning; proceed past it. Once logged in, click the padlock icon in the address bar, then select “View certificates.” In the Certificate dialog, go to the “Details” tab and click “Copy to File…” Follow the Certificate Export Wizard to save the certificate as a .CER file. Next, double-click the saved file and choose “Install Certificate.” Select “Local Machine” as the store location (you’ll need admin rights), then place the certificate in the “Trusted Root Certification Authorities” store. After installation, restart your device. Finally, reconfigure your email account in the Windows 8 Mail app—it should now connect seamlessly to the Exchange server

col3: PHILADELPHIA-- A Philadelphia woman, distressed over her household allowance, will serve 11 months in prison for planning a staged kidnapping to extort funds from her husband. Authorities report that Yudeka Valdez protested that her estranged husband failed to cover payments for her Mercedes. She allegedly informed the purported kidnappers that her husband dealt heroin and stored $20,000 in cash at home. However, the men were an undercover agent and an informant. Following her 2008 arrest, Valdez claimed she never intended to execute the scheme. col0: I think many people would agree that most of the magazines currently available on the iPad are not great. Digital editions too often feel like hollow echoes: flat, hurried, stripped of soul. They mimic form but miss rhythm, sacrificing serendipity for slickness, depth for speed. Where’s the margin for daydreaming? The quiet rebellion of dog-eared corners? Even the boldest layouts dissolve into sameness under the glare of a screen. True design breathes; it invites lingering, not swiping. Until digital magazines honor texture as much as text, until they embrace the human pace behind reading—not just consumption—they’ll remain beautiful ghosts, haunting a space they haven’t yet learned to inhabit.

These included likings for products as disparate as science fiction movies and hybrid cars.The authors, Itamar Simonson of Stanford University and Aner Sela of the University of Florida, examined "a wide range of consumer judgment and decision-making phenomena". Hong Kong (CNN) In a contemporary take on public shaming, a court in China has prominently displayed the names and violations of 50 individuals and four companies that avoided paying fines.

Their photographs and personal details have been showcased on a large electronic screen outside a major railway station in Changsha, located in China's southern Hunan province.

As captured by Chinese state television, curious spectators and travelers assembled outside the busy station, watching as a succession of individual portraits, ID numbers, their offenses, and amounts of unpaid court fines scrolled across a massive digital billboard.

Rather than showing advertisements, the screen functions as a public "wall of shame" for those who neglected to pay court-imposed fines for breaching property disclosure regulations, defying court orders, or ignoring subpoenas.

The outstanding fines vary from 10,000 yuan ($1,600) to 29 million yuan ($4.5 million).

A series of earthquakes measuring 3.0 or greater shook northern Oklahoma from Wednesday night into early Thursday. Numerous residents contacted CBS affiliate KWTV in Oklahoma City, describing prolonged shaking, with some noting damage to their properties.

The U.S. Geological Survey recorded a magnitude-4.7 quake shortly before 10:30 p.m. Wednesday, approximately 20 miles northwest of Fairview. Less than a minute later, a magnitude-4.8 quake was detected about half a mile away. While quakes of this intensity can cause moderate damage, Fairview police had no immediate reports of injuries or structural harm.

USGS geophysicist Dale Grant stated the tremors were likely felt across an eight-state region. KWTV reported at least 11 additional quakes, ranging from magnitude 3.0 to 4.0, occurred within hours, following several earlier on Wednesday.

Oklahoma has experienced many small to moderate quakes lately, associated with underground wastewater injection from oil and gas operations. State regulators have mandated reduced volumes or closures for some disposal wells.

col0: When people urge the removal of dams they say are strangling rivers in the West, it’s usually fish they’re worried about. Studies of dam-removal projects—like those on the Elwha and Klamath Rivers—show salmon populations bouncing back faster than expected once barriers come down. But it’s not just about the fish. Restoring free-flowing rivers also revives entire ecosystems: birds return, insects thrive, and even forests along riverbanks get healthier thanks to nutrient-rich sediments that once again travel downstream. Plus, many Indigenous communities see dam removal as a step toward healing cultural ties to ancestral waterways disrupted for generations. Of course, dams do provide hydropower and water storage, so decisions aren’t simple. But as climate change intensifies droughts and wildfires, flexible, nature-based solutions are gaining traction. Turns out, letting rivers run wild again might be one of the smartest moves we can make—for wildlife, people, and the planet.

What does 'Hold a candle' mean?  
The phrase 'can't hold a candle to' describes someone who falls short compared to an established expert—being unqualified even for a minor supporting role.  
What is the origin of 'Hold a candle'?  
Apprentices were once tasked with holding candles to provide light for skilled craftsmen at work. Failing at such a simple duty would indicate very low competence.  
Sir Edward Dering employed a comparable expression, 'to hold the candle,' in his 1641 work, The fower cardinal-vertues of a Carmelite fryar:  
"Though I be not worthy to hold the candle to Aristotle."

col0: For the first time, researchers have disabled a gene in human embryos to learn about its function. Using molecular scissors called CRISPR/Cas9, scientists precisely edited the genome of early-stage embryos to investigate the role of OCT4, a gene suspected to be critical in embryonic development. The study, conducted under strict ethical oversight and using non-implantable embryos, revealed that OCT4 is essential for the formation of the blastocyst—a structure vital for successful implantation in the uterus. Embryos lacking functional OCT4 exhibited significant developmental failure, underscoring the gene’s pivotal role during the earliest stages of human life. This research marks a significant advance in understanding human embryogenesis and offers insights that may improve in vitro fertilization (IVF) techniques and inform regenerative medicine. However, the work also reiterates the necessity of robust ethical frameworks governing germline genome editing, as such interventions carry profound implications for future generations and societal norms surrounding genetic modification.

col0: For most of the frogs and toads in the world, during breeding season, the male frog calls out to the female frogs to attract them. For each species, these calls are unique—ranging from deep croaks to high-pitched trills—and serve as acoustic signatures that help females identify suitable mates of their own kind. The calls are produced by inflating vocal sacs located under the chin or at the corners of the mouth, amplifying the sound across ponds, marshes, or forest floors. Environmental factors like temperature, humidity, and time of night can influence both the frequency and intensity of these calls. In some species, males even gather in choruses, creating a competitive symphony where the loudest or most persistent caller often wins a mate. This vocal behavior is not only crucial for reproduction but also plays a role in establishing territory among rival males. Thus, the humble frog call is a sophisticated tool of communication shaped by evolution to ensure species survival.

col0: The study of the syntax–semantics interface is concerned with linguistic phenomena that are the product of interactions between principles of syntactic organization and principles of semantic interpretation. Such interactions abound in natural language and can be found in all subsystems of the grammar. This paper examines a particular subclass of such phenomena revolving around quantificational expressions. The central concern of the discussion are the grammatical mechanisms that mediate between the syntactic position a quantifier appears in and the semantic import it has on the sentence meaning. Of particular interest are cases where a quantifier is interpreted in a position that is different from the position it seems to occupy in the syntax. A leading hypothesis to explain cases of this sort, which exemplify a general property of natural language called displacement, is that they are the product of overt or covert movement operations. Empirical support for this approach is presented in the form of correlations between three grammatical phenomena – Quantifier Scope, Antecedent Contained Deletion, and Extraposition – which receive a uniform account under the above hypothesis.

Summary: This paper examines if the clarity of central bank inflation reports impacts return volatility in financial markets. Clarity is assessed for reports from the Czech National Bank, the European Central Bank, the Bank of England, and Sveriges Riksbank using the Flesch-Kincaid grade level, a common readability metric. col0: NOMAS (National Organization for Men Against Sexism), strongly opposes the use of “Anger Management” or Anger Management Programs as a primary intervention for men who perpetrate domestic violence or other forms of gender-based harm. Such programs often mischaracterize abusive behavior as an emotional regulation issue rather than a deliberate exercise of power and control rooted in systemic sexism. By framing violence as a symptom of uncontrolled anger, these approaches risk minimizing accountability and obscuring the intentional nature of abusive conduct. NOMAS advocates for interventions grounded in feminist analysis that address the underlying beliefs and social structures enabling male violence. Effective responses must emphasize perpetrator accountability, promote healthy masculinities, and center the safety and autonomy of survivors. Anger management may have a role in addressing general emotional health, but it is wholly inadequate—and potentially dangerous—when applied to intimate partner violence without confronting its patriarchal foundations.
